one_liner: SpeedTrail_v0.1 adds configurable particle trails and landing bursts for players, triggering on ground movement and high‑speed descents (client‑only).
primary_use_case: visual player motion feedback via particle trails and landing bursts
preview_recommendation: Use the provided mp4 preview to verify the particle trail visual on descent and landing; note that the effect is client‑only and may not appear for other players.
